How do I get tree sap off my car in Washington?





The safest way to get tree sap off your car is to start with warm soapy water, then use isopropyl alcohol or a dedicated sap remover if needed, working gently to avoid scratching the clear coat.

Washington’s common trees—pine, maple, birch, and walnut—produce sticky resin that can drip onto cars and harden quickly in sun or warm weather
